title: From Four Spatial Dimensions to Three: The Physical Origin of Time, Energy, and Angular Momentum in World—Universe Cosmology
summary: World—Universe Cosmology (WUC) proposes that the physical World is a finite, boundless three-dimensional Hypersphere forming the surface of an expanding four-dimensional Nucleus embedded in the Eternal Universe. The Nucleus expands at the fundamental speed c , and the radius of curvature of the Hypersphere is determined by the evolving World Parameter Q .Within this framework, the Eternal Universe continuously generates Universe-Created Matter (UCM) through the formation of Universe-Created Particles (UCPs) within the expanding Nucleus.
